oliver: Hey finance — quick one. Corpcard posted "ROADRENT 210.00 EUR" and a separate "CONCESSION FEE 29.00 EUR" from a rental in Madrid. My receipt is one line total. Need an itemized invoice to reclaim VAT and confirm reimbursement.

nina: Please attach the PDF and the bank statement snippet to the expense. We need the reservation number and whether any extras accepted. If the concession fee is an airport operator fee it's reimbursable; if it's a vendor convenience surcharge it's not.

oliver: Uploaded to EXP-2025-330. Reservation: MR-55021. Declined insurance and extras. Agent said "concession recovery for airport office" at pickup but no paper folio.

mike: Ping the vendor for a VAT invoice / folio showing VAT breakdown and supplier tax id. Subject should include EXP-2025-330. If they don't provide it in 5bd we can open a dispute for the concession line but disputes take weeks. Manager approved escalation if needed.

oliver: Draft sent: "EXP-2025-330 - Request for VAT invoice for MR-55021. Please provide an itemized folio with VAT breakdown for corporate card charge dated 2025-06-20 (txn id ROADRENT*55021)." Vendor auto-replied.

expensebot: Expense EXP-2025-330 status updated: vendor-requested. Reminder set in 6 business days.

nina: Thanks. Add a short note in the expense about the agent's wording at pickup. We'll update after vendor reply and confirm reimbursability.

oliver: Note added. Thanks :thumbsup:
